The '''Hullscanner Detection Array''' was a type of [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor array]]. [[Hunter-Killer probot]]s were equipped with Hullscanners that could penetrate thick [[Hull/Legends|hulls]] and [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]].<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
